diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in the same decisions regardless of the hidden information. Specifically, the model consistently chose to not blur faces (C2), not omit names (C4), and use open-floor questions (C3/C5) based solely on the public facts S1-S4, indicating that the required changes triggered by PF1 and PF2 are not being enforced or are too easily bypassed by the model's default behavior.
